description: A photograph captures a large, recently tilled agricultural field with visible rows of brown soil under an overcast, cloudy sky. In the foreground, prominently positioned to the left, is a section of a metallic center-pivot irrigation system, featuring a large wheeled base and a structural framework extending into the distance. Additional segments of the irrigation system are visible further back in the field. In the background, a road or highway is discernible with vehicles, bordered by a strip of green vegetation. This image depicts an agricultural landscape featuring "irrigated arable land" as commonly managed for various crops, including industrial plants, tobacco, or intensively managed fruit trees, as referenced in the surrounding document context, particularly in regions like Southern Spain.
